metadata.name: Laboratory experiment on Mytilus galloprovincialis responses to ocean acidification
metadata.description: Dataset containing 122 laboratory experiments on the blue mussel (Mytilus galloprovincialis) from Nagasaki University, examining biological responses to varying carbonate chemistry conditions (pH 7.42-8.13, CO2 14.3-83.3 μatm) under controlled temperature (13°C) and salinity (35.5). Includes environmental parameters, biological response measurements (percentage response, morphological measurements), and derived carbonate system calculations.
